originalRequest: Really redesign that admin panel. It is absolutely hideous.
subject: Interactive Learning’s existing authenticated admin panel at /admin.
scope: Substantial visual and usability redesign of the admin page, including user timeouts, quota resets, user directory, role controls, and interaction states. Retain the surrounding application shell and existing functionality.
primaryGoal: Make account administration clear, cohesive, and easy to scan, with obvious user selection, permissions, action scope, and feedback.
audience: Interactive Learning CEOs and Head Moderators. Quota resets and role management are CEO-only.
offer: An administration workspace for managing temporary access restrictions, restoring allowances, and assigning account roles.
primaryAction: Find and select an account, then perform the permitted account-management action; clearly distinguish global quota resets from individual changes.
creativeControl: Broad discretion to substantially improve hierarchy, grouping, spacing, density, typography treatment, and control presentation within the established brand and existing functional scope. Choose the final visual composition after reference selection.
requiredContent: Admin context and access: Admin title, concise explanation of account controls, and access-checking and restricted-access states.

Timeout user search and selection: Search loaded users by name, handle, or account ID; load additional users; show selected account, active timeout status, CEO-cleared status, and management restrictions.

Selected user timeout controls: Account identity, active timeout expiry and reason, reason entry, duration from 1 to 43,200 minutes, and start, restart, or end timeout actions. Explain applicable role restrictions and automatic expiry.

CEO allowance reset controls: Choose everyone or a specific account, select daily Experience browsing time and/or daily bot-message allowances, review the target scope, confirm the reset, and receive success or error feedback.

CEO user directory and roles: Search accounts by name, handle, email, or account ID; select an account for an individual reset; manage CEO, Head Moderator, Moderator, and Member roles. Preserve the restriction against changing one’s own role.
Operational interaction states: Consistent loading, empty search, no selection, restricted, disabled, saving, success, and error states integrated into the relevant controls.
constraints: Preserve existing authentication, role-based visibility, permission enforcement, data integrations, validation, and action semantics.
Preserve confirmation for quota resets and make global effects explicit.
Support desktop and mobile, existing light and dark themes, keyboard interaction, visible focus, accessible labels, and readable status feedback.
Keep the redesign scoped to the admin interface rather than changing the entire application or brand.
Retain reliable role selection behavior; the existing component documents a runtime issue with portalled custom selects.
Use supplied or subsequently selected reference images to guide each section’s desktop and mobile composition. Reference selection belongs to a later phase.
Do not add unsupported analytics, audit logs, fabricated account data, or decorative marketing sections.
brandInputs: src/lib/brand.ts: Brand name is Interactive Learning; tagline is The visual learning platform. Brand ink is #0f0f0f and paper is #ffffff. The IL monogram remains monochrome.

src/app/globals.css: Existing blue primary #3c85f7, light background #f7f7f7, white cards, gray borders #e3e3e3, and dark background #0f0f0f with cards #171717. Rounded surfaces, subtle borders, and theme-aware semantic tokens.
src/app/layout.tsx: Inter is the brand typeface. Instrument Serif is also available for display typography.
public/brand/ and src/lib/brand.ts: Existing IL monogram and logo lockup assets are available; reuse the established identity.
src/app/(app)/layout.tsx and src/components/ui/page.tsx: Existing sidebar application shell with an independently scrolling, rounded content surface and responsive page gutters.

src/components/app/admin/admin-console.tsx, timeout-console.tsx, and quota-console.tsx: Current page stacks a timeout card above CEO controls, which place quota reset controls alongside a searchable directory. Styling uses bordered cards, rounded inputs, muted descriptions, and blue actions.
assumptions: The referenced admin panel is the verified /admin route in this project.
The request authorizes a substantial presentation and usability overhaul while preserving existing capabilities and permission rules.
This is a focused operational interface, so its actual workflows determine the content scope; an eight-section landing-page structure would add filler.
Keep the existing brand, application shell, and theme preferences rather than introduce a new brand system.
Use restrained interaction feedback and respect reduced-motion preferences; entrance and scroll animation requirements for new websites do not apply to this existing admin redesign.
Use live application data in the finished interface; any later design-preview sample data must be clearly illustrative.
unresolved: No design reference images were supplied. Desktop and mobile composition references remain to be selected in the subsequent design phase.
The current appearance was assessed from relevant source files, not a rendered authenticated session.
